Where to paste your prompt
ChatGPT Gemini Claude NotebookLM ★
All are free to start. NotebookLM is best when you want answers only from your own uploaded notes — nothing off-syllabus.
Using NotebookLM (recommended)
1
Open notebooklm.google.com and click New notebook.
2
Add Sources — upload your notes / textbook / past-paper PDFs (up to 50 files). This is your "material".
3
Paste a prompt from below into the chat box and press Enter.
4
Get answers — plus a mind-map, audio overview or study guide, all made from your material.
